items.label: A1 — Model adaptation truth
items.purpose: Converge one coherent current model-adaptation truth from existing model source facts, Companion representation, exact current-target runtime realization/qualification and separately-qualified relationships such as visual input or provider-native tooling. Keep RECOGNIZED != QUALIFIED, let failed optional relationships hold or fall back without rejecting the whole model, derive effective capabilities from one current serving observation, and project that truth to the person without making Models UI another capability authority.

items.purpose: Reuse the already-landed Models Select versus Start/Use semantics and runtime-switch custody so one human target converges to one exact serving model only after qualification. Re-evaluate the substantial existing selector/switch implementation after A1 rather than rebuilding it, and preserve the rule that model selection or source change never silently rebinds Conversation, Memory, artifacts or Local Sources.

Today's public Qwen3 MLX/Safetensors recognizer remains patient zero; add another recognizer only when a real runtime/adapter relationship earns it.
